Funnel all session-state mutations through MutateSessionState

The previous PostToolUse-only lock fixed parallel PostToolUse races but
left every other writer (TurnEnd, PostCommit, condense, model update,
review env adoption, attribution divergence, post-rewrite remap, etc.)
doing its own unlocked load → mutate → save. A PostToolUse save could
still revert Phase, CheckpointTranscriptStart, TurnCheckpointIDs, token
usage, and other fields if it landed between another writer's load and
save.

Convert every session-state load-modify-save in the lifecycle dispatcher
and strategy package to MutateSessionState (or, for the rare new-state
case, to wrap the lone save in acquireSessionGate). The helper now:
  - Takes an OS flock against .git/entire-session-locks/<id>.lock for
    the duration of the load + fn + save.
  - Layers a per-process gate keyed by goroutine ID over the flock so
    nested calls in the same goroutine share the outer's state pointer
    rather than deadlocking on a second flock or losing inner updates
    to the outer save.
  - Returns ErrStateNotFound when no state file exists, letting callers
    distinguish "no session" from a successful no-op.
  - Honours ErrMutationSkip so fn can decline to save when the merge
    produced no change (key for the PostToolUse hot path).

Lock files moved out of .git/entire-sessions/ so callers that enumerate
session state (tests, doctor, status) don't have to filter them.
ClearSessionState sweeps the lock too.

Fix Cursor session mis-identified as Claude Code

When Cursor IDE forwards a single user prompt to both .cursor/hooks.json
and .claude/settings.json, two `entire` hook processes race to claim the
session and the loser's wrong agent_type can win the last write.

Three layered defenses:
- SessionStart hint: first agent to fire claims the session ID
  (`<sessionID>.agent` written with O_EXCL).
- Transcript-path override: a transcript inside an agent's session dir
  is authoritative — overrides both hint and the firing hook.
- Per-session file lock: serializes concurrent InitializeSession calls
  so the runner-up takes the cheap update path (`correctSessionAgentType`)
  instead of also creating-from-scratch. Lock files live under
  `<git-common-dir>/entire-locks/` to keep `entire-sessions/` clean.

limit and will allocate as needed.

# Carry Forward: Preserve Uncommitted Files After Condensation

## Context

When an agent makes multiple commits within a single turn (e.g., commits 2 of 3 edited files, then commits the third), the second commit currently gets no checkpoint. After the first commit condenses, `StepCount` resets to 0, `FilesTouched` is cleared, and the shadow branch is deleted. The second commit sees no session data to condense.

**Goal:** After condensation, if the session still has uncommitted files that were touched during the session, create a new shadow branch at the new HEAD carrying those remaining files + all metadata. This ensures every commit gets its own checkpoint.
